ideas.title: Following the Money: An Investigation into Federal Funding Misuse
ideas.description: This story would investigate the use of federal funds by non-profit organizations and identify any instances of misuse or fraud.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records investigation
questions: How much federal funding has been allocated to non-profit organizations in the past year?
What oversight mechanisms are in place to prevent misuse of federal funds?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread misuse of federal funds and highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability.
